goal: Test bipartite gravity-induced correlations in separated mass superpositions
controls: residual free charge measurement and bound
blind data and predetermined witness threshold
required_data: raw repeated readout on both systems
two-system density matrix tomography or a valid entanglement witness
null controls with suppressed gravitational phase

hypotheses.H0: no quantum entanglement beyond calibrated backgrounds
hypotheses.H1: measured bipartite entanglement consistent with Newtonian interaction under specified assumptions

failure_conditions: known quantum information channel between masses
only a phase shift, no entanglement witness
interpretation as unconditional proof of graviton quantization
safety: All simulated numbers are synthetic; actual experimental protocol requires institutional safety and metrology review
